_help.client.url: The game's own crash server (made with npm run crashes:deploy — going live is Muzzy's call), e.g. https://goops-crashes.joebrogno.workers.dev. Empty = the game catches errors but sends nothing.
_help.client.perSession: Reports one play session (one open tab) may send, at most. Each kind of error is only sent once per session anyway; repeats are just counted.
_help.client.moments: How many of the last game moments (code names like roundStart + numbers, never text a player typed) go with a report, so you can see what led up to it.
_help.client.sendInDev: true = the dev build (npm run dev) sends reports too — only to try the server out. Leave false so your own testing isn't counted.
_help.server.perAddressPerHour: Reports one address (a home or a school shares one) may send in an hour; past that they're dropped. The address is never stored. Redeploy the crash server after changing a server value.
_help.server.perDay: Reports the whole game may store in a day (UTC). Past that only a count goes up. Keeps the Cloudflare account's shared allowance (100,000 requests a day, online play included) safe.
_help.server.newKindsPerDay: New kinds of error the server takes in a day, so a flood of made-up ones can't fill it.
_help.server.samplesPerKindPerDay: Full reports kept for one kind of error per day; past that the kind is only counted.
_help.server.samplesPerKind: Full reports kept for one kind of error in all; the newest replace the oldest.
_help.server.keepDays: Days reports are kept before they're deleted (and a kind not seen for that long). The privacy line says this number. Muzzy 2026-10-22: 90.
